parameters.query:
-- 1. Mentor-Mentee Pairs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Pairs (
  id                UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  mentee_name       VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  mentee_email      VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  mentor_name       VARCHAR(255),
  mentor_email      VARCHAR(255),
  cohort_start_date DATE NOT NULL,
  status            VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 2. Quarterly Cycles (one per pair per quarter)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Cycles (
  id                        UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  pair_id                   UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Pairs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quarter                   INT NOT NULL CHECK (quarter BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
  cycle_start_date          DATE NOT NULL,
  meeting_confirmed_mentee  BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  meeting_confirmed_mentor  BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  meeting_confirmed_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
  status                    VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at                TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at                TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(pair_id, quarter)
);

-- 3. Goals (submitted by mentee and mentor each quarter)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Goals (
  id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  pair_id            UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Pairs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  cycle_id           UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Cycles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quarter            INT NOT NULL,
  submitted_by       VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (submitted_by IN ('mentee','mentor')),
  goal_1             TEXT,
  goal_2             TEXT,
  goal_3             TEXT,
  additional_context TEXT,
  submitted_at       TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 4. Feedback (AI-generated questions + responses)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Feedback (
  id                UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  cycle_id          UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Cycles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pair_id           UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Pairs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quarter           INT NOT NULL,
  submitted_by      VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (submitted_by IN ('mentee','mentor')),
  ai_questions      JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
  responses         JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
  submitted_at      TIMESTAMPTZ
);

-- 5. Tokens (one-time links for goals, confirmations, feedback)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Tokens (
  id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  token        VARCHAR(128) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  pair_id      UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Pairs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  cycle_id     UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Cycles(id),
  person_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  person_role  VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (person_role IN ('mentee','mentor')),
  token_type   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  used         BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  expires_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 6. Escalations (HR alerts for unconfirmed meetings)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Escalations (
  id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  cycle_id            UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Cycles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pair_id             UUID REFERENCES HR_MentorMe_Pairs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  week_triggered      INT NOT NULL,
  escalation_sent_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  resolved            BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
);

SELECT
  p.id AS pair_id,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.cohort_start_date,
  GREATEST(1, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1) AS current_week,
  CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS current_quarter,
  qc.id AS cycle_id,
  COALESCE(qc.status, 'no_cycle') AS cycle_status,
  COALESCE(qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee, FALSE) AS confirmed_mentee,
  COALESCE(qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor, FALSE) AS confirmed_mentor
FROM table_2 p
LEFT JOIN table_3 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END
WHERE (p.pair_status = 'active' OR p.status = 'active')
AND p.mentor_email IS NOT NULL
AND p.mentor_email != ''
AND p.cohort_start_date <= NOW()

INSERT INTO table_3 (pair_id, quarter, cycle_start_date, status)
VALUES ('{{ $json.pair_id }}'::UUID, {{ $json.current_quarter }}, NOW()::DATE, 'pending')
ON CONFLICT (pair_id, quarter) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id AS cycle_id;

-- Table columns
SELECT 
  table_name,
  column_name,
  data_type,
  column_default,
  is_nullable
FROM table_8
WHERE table_name LIKE 'hr_mentorme_%'
ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;

-- Constraints (primary keys, unique, foreign keys, checks)
SELECT
  tc.table_name,
  tc.constraint_name,
  tc.constraint_type,
  kcu.column_name,
  ccu.table_name AS foreign_table,
  ccu.column_name AS foreign_column
FROM table_9 tc
JOIN table_10 kcu
  ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
  AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
LEFT JOIN table_11 ccu
  ON tc.constraint_name = ccu.constraint_name
  AND tc.table_schema = ccu.table_schema
WHERE tc.table_name LIKE 'hr_mentorme_%'
ORDER BY tc.table_name, tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- MentorMe Phase 2 — Database Setup
-- Run this entire script in one go
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- 1. Mentor Profiles
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Mentor_Profiles (
  id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email               VARCHAR NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name                VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  department          VARCHAR,
  location            VARCHAR,
  gender              VARCHAR,
  role                VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mentor', -- mentor | both
  personal_statement  TEXT,
  is_active           BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  cohort_mentee_count INT DEFAULT 0,
  profile_submitted   BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 2. Mentee Directory
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Mentee_Directory (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email         VARCHAR NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name          VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  department    VARCHAR,
  location      VARCHAR,
  gender        VARCHAR,
  role          VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mentee', -- mentee | both
  cohort_name   VARCHAR,
  status        VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_selection',
  -- pending_selection | paired | graduated | exited
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3. Status Log (audit trail for onboarded vs exits metric)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Status_Log (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  person_type   VARCHAR NOT NULL, -- mentee | mentor
  person_email  VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  old_status    VARCHAR,
  new_status    VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  changed_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 4. Cohorts
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS HR_MentorMe_Cohorts (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  cohort_name   VARCHAR NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- e.g. "Cohort 1 2026"
  cohort_number INT NOT NULL,            -- 1 or 2
  cohort_year   INT NOT NULL,
  start_date    DATE NOT NULL,
  status        VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  -- pending | active | completed
  launched_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 5. Alter HR_MentorMe_Pairs — add cohort columns
ALTER TABLE HR_MentorMe_Pairs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cohort_name   VARCHAR,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cohort_number INT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cohort_year   INT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pair_status   VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending';
  -- pending | active | completed

-- 6. Indexes for common lookups
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mentor_profiles_email    ON HR_MentorMe_Mentor_Profiles(email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mentee_directory_email   ON HR_MentorMe_Mentee_Directory(email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mentee_directory_status  ON HR_MentorMe_Mentee_Directory(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_status_log_email         ON HR_MentorMe_Status_Log(person_email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_status_log_changed_at    ON HR_MentorMe_Status_Log(changed_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cohorts_status           ON HR_MentorMe_Cohorts(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pairs_cohort             ON HR_MentorMe_Pairs(cohort_name);

-- 7. Seed the two 2026 cohorts
INSERT INTO table_12 (cohort_name, cohort_number, cohort_year, start_date, status)
VALUES
  ('Cohort 1 2026', 1, 2026, '2026-01-05', 'active'),
  ('Cohort 2 2026', 2, 2026, '2026-07-06', 'pending')
ON CONFLICT (cohort_name) DO NOTHING;

-- Note: 2026-01-05 = first Monday of January 2026
-- Note: 2026-07-06 = first Monday of July 2026

INSERT INTO table_13 (person_type, person_email, old_status, new_status)
SELECT
  'mentor',
  LOWER(TRIM('{{$json.email}}')),
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT CASE WHEN is_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END
     FROM table_14
     column_11 LOWER(TRIM('{{$json.email}}'))),
    'new'
  ),
  LOWER(TRIM('{{$json.status}}'))
WHERE
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT CASE WHEN is_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END
     FROM table_14
     column_11 LOWER(TRIM('{{$json.email}}'))),
    'new'
  ) != LOWER(TRIM('{{$json.status}}'))
ON CONFLICT (person_type, person_email, old_status, new_status) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO table_14
  (email, name, department, location, gender, role, is_active, updated_at)
VALUES (
  LOWER(TRIM('{{$json.email}}')),
  TRIM('{{$json.name}}'),

parameters.query:
SELECT
  p.id          AS pair_id,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.cohort_name,
  p.cohort_start_date,
  GREATEST(1, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1) AS current_week,
  CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS current_quarter,
  CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 12
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 24
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 36
    ELSE 48
  END AS quarter_end_week,
  qc.status     AS cycle_status,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor
FROM table_2 p
LEFT JOIN table_3 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = (
    CASE
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 1
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 2
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END
  )
WHERE
  p.pair_status = 'active'
  AND (
    (qc.status IS NULL OR qc.status = 'pending')
    AND (
      CASE
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 12
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 24
        WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 36
        ELSE 48
      END - GREATEST(1, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)
    ) <= 2
  );

-- Dashboard metrics
SELECT
  'metrics' AS query_type,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_19 'active') AS active_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_19 'pending') AS pending_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_19 'completed') AS completed_pairs,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mentor_email) FROM table_2 column_19 'active') AS active_mentors,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 column_2 'confirmed' column_2 'feedback_sent') AS meetings_confirmed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_3 column_2 'escalated') AS escalations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_7 WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS feedback_submitted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_6) AS goals_submitted,
  (SELECT cohort_name FROM table_12 column_2 'pending' ORDER BY start_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS next_cohort_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2 column_19 'pending') AS next_cohort_pending_pairs;

SELECT
  p.id          AS pair_id,
  p.mentee_name,
  p.mentee_email,
  p.mentor_name,
  p.mentor_email,
  p.cohort_name,
  p.pair_status,
  p.cohort_start_date,
  GREATEST(1, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1) AS current_week,
  CASE
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 1
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 2
    WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS current_quarter,
  qc.status     AS cycle_status,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentee,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_mentor,
  qc.meeting_confirmed_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_6 g WHERE g.pair_id = p.id AND g.submitted_by = 'mentee') AS goals_submitted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_6 g WHERE g.pair_id = p.id) AS total_goal_records,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_7 f WHERE f.cycle_id = qc.id AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS feedback_submitted_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_5 e WHERE e.pair_id = p.id) AS escalation_count,
  (
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'goal_1', g.goal_1,
      'goal_2', g.goal_2,
      'goal_3', g.goal_3,
      'additional_context', g.additional_context,
      'submitted_by', g.submitted_by,
      'quarter', g.quarter
    ))
    FROM table_6 g
    WHERE g.pair_id = p.id
  ) AS goals_detail,
  CASE
    WHEN (
      (qc.status IS NULL OR qc.status = 'pending')
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 12
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 24
          WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 36
          ELSE 48
        END - GREATEST(1, (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) + 1)
      ) <= 2
    ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
  END AS end_of_quarter_flag
FROM table_2 p
LEFT JOIN table_3 qc
  ON qc.pair_id = p.id
  AND qc.quarter = (
    CASE
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 12 THEN 1
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 24 THEN 2
      WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM table_1() - p.cohort_start_date)::INT / 7) < 36 THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END
  )
ORDER BY p.cohort_name ASC, p.mentee_name ASC;
